anti_patterns: OBSERVE -> REPORT -> STOP while an authorized unique next action exists
CI_SUCCESS -> WAIT without invoking a next-action selector
DRAFT_STABLE -> WAIT when repository policy permits a bounded history-preserving continuation
MATERIALIZED_TREE -> WAIT when a trusted zero-diff carrier is uniquely required
ISSUE_CLASSIFIED -> WAIT when an authorized repository-native work unit is uniquely determined
truth_boundary: Continuation never manufactures external authority, independent review, merge, publication, deployment, credentials, PASS, FINAL_PASS or EFFECT_ACK_DONE.
